PROJECT_NAME.prompt: Project name as agents should refer to it
PROJECT_NAME.infer: package.json name, else the repo folder name

AI_DIR.prompt: Repo-relative folder for agent working files (journals, follow-ups, resources)

DEFAULT_BRANCH.prompt: Integration branch feature work branches from and PRs target

STACK_SUMMARY.prompt: One-line stack summary (e.g. "Next.js 16 / React 19 / TypeScript / Tailwind 4")
STACK_SUMMARY.infer: framework and tool dependencies in package.json

DEV_CMD.prompt: Command that starts the app locally

LOCAL_URL.prompt: URL the local dev server serves

VERIFY_CMD.prompt: The one command that runs every quality gate (typecheck, lint, tests, …)
VERIFY_CMD.infer: a verify/check/ci script, else the gates chained with &&

CONVENTIONS_DIR.prompt: Repo-relative folder holding the convention docs agents read (stack profile, test quality, …)
CONVENTIONS_DIR.infer: an existing conventions/ folder holding .md files

COMMENT_POLICY_PATH.prompt: Repo-relative path of the comment policy
COMMENT_POLICY_PATH.infer: an existing comment-policy.md anywhere in the repo

PR_GUIDE_PATH.prompt: Repo-relative path of the commit and pull-request guidelines

GOTCHAS_PATH.prompt: Repo-relative path of the hard-won-lessons file

STYLE_GUIDE_DIR.prompt: Repo-relative folder holding the prose style guides
